apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: github-actions-runner-controller-registry
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: github-actions-runner-controller-registry
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: github-actions-runner-controller-registry
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: registry
        image: registry:2
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5000
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/registry
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
        securityContext:
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      volumes:
      - name: data
        emptyDir: {}

          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        resources:
          requests:
